core_messages_shared: A bowl of plain porridge is only half the power; adding wild eboo or cowpea leaves makes the brain sharp for class.
Water fetching belongs to both brothers and sisters. When brothers carry the first jerrican, sisters arrive at 7:30 AM without caning.
Cover your cooking pot and extinguish glowing embers with ash to save tomorrow's firewood.

dimensions.title: Pillar 2: Gender Dynamics & Equitable Morning Chores
